era: 2019 roblox.com before the late-2019 light/dark refresh: 40px #0074bd header with the white 2016 ROBLOX wordmark, white 16px Games / Catalog / Create / Robux links, a white search box and white Robux, notification and settings icons; a 175px white left column (Home, Profile, Messages, Friends, Avatar, Inventory, Trade, Groups, My Feed, Blog, Official Store, Gift Cards) in 16px medium text; #e3e3e3 page with white game cards (16px medium names), blue 'See All' buttons, white footer with grey links, in Gotham SSm.
